details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds read and infinite loop in the *_toUtf16
     converters used by the -DXML_UNICODE build (libexpatw)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-72522.patch: only treat a trailing high
       surrogate (0xD800-0xDBFF) as a split surrogate pair in
       DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16(), masking with 0xFC instead of 0xF8
       (libexpat PR #1296).
     - CVE-2026-72522
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free through same-parser calls made from the
     application's custom encoding callbacks
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-76957.patch: route the unknown-encoding
       convert and release callbacks through the handler call depth
       tracking so XML_Parse, XML_ParseBuffer, XML_GetBuffer, XML_ParserFree
       and XML_ParserReset are rejected from inside them (libexpat PR #1322).
     - CVE-2026-76957
